fact: Digital Earth Africa and SASSCAL agreed to build the AgriWatch dashboard on DE Africa Earth-observation products for crop-cycle, rangeland and rainfall monitoring, with AgriWatch covering this country among the six SASSCAL states.

AICCRA reports that Zambia's National Crop Monitor, a GIS-based GEOGLAM tool using MODIS, VIIRS, CHIRPS, Landsat and Sentinel 2 data, was launched at a Lusaka workshop with provincial teams from Zambia's 10 provinces.
